messages:
Nora Blake: Heads-up  Synaptix (enterprise legal tech) wants to onboard a tuned `starling-13b-legal` variant for a security-sensitive POC. Theyre asking: can we serve their HF checkpoint + LoRA, what quant/variant to recommend for p95 <160ms, and a Dedicated ballpark. Also they require data isolation and an executed DPA/KMS.
Diego Ramos: Do we know if the checkpoint includes any custom tokenizer or special tokens? Legal models often add clause markers which break tokenization. Ask them to run a tokenizer dump or share tokenizer.json.
Nora Blake: Buyer said it's a full checkpoint plus a tiny LoRA for legal formatting. Private HF link will be shared after DPA.
Priya Venkatar: Runtime quick take: starling-13b is similar shape to other 13B models. NF4 on H100 looks best for latency/cost; fallback 8-bit on A100. For p95 <160ms on short dialogs (~70 tokens) recommend H100 x1 with continuous batching and KV cache warmers during pilot; if they need guaranteed throughput at scale suggest 2x H100 reserved.
Priya Venkatar: Suggested smoke config:
```
variant: starling-13b-legal-nf4
quant: nf4
hw: h100
max_batch: 6
max_seq: 512
warmers: kv-cache-enabled
fallback: starling-13b-legal-8bit
```
Harrison Cole: Ops/security notes: for legal data they requested tenant isolation + audit logs. We can do Dedicated with customer-managed KMS + VPC peering or Private deployment. Need signed DPA and SOC2 report.
Diego Ramos: SE checklist for onboarding:
1) tokenizer sanity: `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --repo synaptix/starling-13b-legal`
2) verify adapter: `python tools/verify_adapter.py --repo synaptix/starling-13b-legal`
3) convert nf4: `python tools/convert_to_nf4.py --in /tmp/weights.pt --out /tmp/weights_nf4.pt`
Note: if the repo contains `.so` or fused kernels we must escalate to security/infra.
Harrison Cole: Pricing ballpark: hosted private pilot (on-demand H100) ~ $8k/mo. Dedicated reserved for stable p95 <160ms: 2x H100 ~ $22k/mo. Add ~12% for HA and burst, +20-30% if they require single-tenant Private deployment with extended retention or custom SLAs.
Nora Blake: Buyer also asked about model provenance and evals. We should run a short legal-regress set (10-15 prompts) to confirm no regression on contract clause extraction.
Priya Venkatar: Agree. Also run NF4 vs 8-bit A/B on the legal-regress-v1 dataset. Small domain tuning sometimes reacts poorly to aggressive quant — we need to confirm.
Diego Ramos: Security checklist request to buyer: dependency list, any patched attention modules, and whether they built any custom CUDA ops. Use `tar -tf repo.tar.gz | grep -E "\\.so$|fused|attn"` to spot compiled libs.
compliance-bot: ticket COMPL-4402 created: "Synaptix  artifact + DPA review" assigned to compliance team.
infra-bot: ticket INF-9201 created: "Synaptix starling-13b-legal onboarding + nf4 smoke" assigned to Diego, Priya, Harrison.
Nora Blake: Action items: (1) I'll request HF link, sample prompts, expected QPS, and dependency list from buyer (2) Diego to run tokenizer + verify adapter by EOD+1 (3) Priya to spin a H100 smoke profile and run latency tests (4) Harrison to draft pricing + DPA/KMS options for SE.
Harrison Cole: If we see custom ops, timeline slips. Flag immediately so infra can plan wheel rebuilds.
Nora Blake: ETA update by EOD tomorrow so we can get this into the term sheet. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
